name: VolunTeen Program
what_you_do: Teens called VolunTeens help at library branches. They follow a weekly work plan and work on their own.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18 who can work on their own and keep a weekly schedule.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page does not say if it is summer only or year-round.
how_to_apply: Fill out the VolunTeen application (a PDF on the page). Go to the orientation meeting, which is required. Ask your local library for details.
notes: The plan differs by library branch.
